thread:
ashwin: Hey team — need to swap my Sat night oncall (11pm-7am PT). Flight delayed, can't cover. Can someone take the shift?

ashwin: Quick handoff notes:
- Active items: small canary rollout of model-v2 (low traffic) scheduled 02:00 PT. Watch Console -> Rollouts for errors. If latency spike >200ms for 5m, revert to model-v1.
- Infra window: DB replica maintenance at 00:30 PT, might cause transient 502s for up to ~3m. Runbook: /runbooks/db-replica-maintenance (steps to monitor + rollback).
- Long-running jobs: nightly embedding backfill runs around 03:30 PT; queue depth might spike — check job-queue metrics.
- Escalation: primary oncall -> infra-sre -> eng-manager. PagerDuty policy: use the "critical-inference" playbook for P1s.
- Helpful commands: `redwoodctl status models`, `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/ingest --tail 200`, `curl -s https://console.redwood/api/health | jq .`

maria: I can pick up the shift, @ashwin — will take 11pm-7am. DM me creds for the private console if needed. :thumbsup:

dan: I'll shadow for the first hour (11-12) to get context and pick up any hot handoffs. If anything escalates to infra, I'll page infra-sre.

ashwin: Thanks @maria and @dan — sending creds and a short DM with the runbook links now. Leaving a couple of one-off notes in the runbook:
- If model rollout fails with >10% error rate, use console -> Rollouts -> revert -> select last-stable.
- For embedding backfill failures, kill and restart with smaller shard size: `jobs backfill --shards 8`

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance (db-replica) will start in ~3h from thread creation time.

jess: FYI — I'm running a config change that shouldn't affect inference, but if you see an auth spike, it could be related. I'll watch logs from 00:00-01:00 PT.

maria: Got the creds and links, thanks. I'll DM if anything unexpected shows up. Taking note of the rollback steps.

dan: Quick question — any sticky alerts I should mute? There are some noisy alert groups for test pipelines.

ashwin: Mute `test-pipeline-failures` and `dev-load-spike` groups for the night, those are expected. Leave production alerts (latency/error) unmuted.

maria: On it. Also setting a short handover note in the oncall doc with timestamps.

ashwin: Appreciate it all — please add any new notes in the thread if something pops up before 11. Will catch up Monday AM. :pray:

maria: :thumbsup: all set, see you Monday.
